items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] and how did you pronounce his first name originally was it Francois or how do you? [INTERVIEWEE] Joseph Francis. Joseph Francis.

ctx.x: No no. To have an easier name you know. No no. It was just by having so much trouble with the insurance. Insurance. He just let it go George Lewis short. But all his children and his wife and
and how did you pronounce his first name originally was it Francois or how do you?
